DEFECT-01 Critical
Transcript Cross-Pollination Across Concurrent Meetings
Area: Transcription pipeline · Multi-session isolation
Issue
Transcriptions from different, concurrent meetings appear to be cross-pollinating. Specifically, text from one meeting's transcript is intermittently appearing in the transcript of another active meeting.
Evidence
DEFECT-02 Medium
Duplicate Bot Instances in Participant List
Area: Bot join / session lifecycle
Issue
While only one or two bots are expected to join, multiple instances are visible in the participants list.
Evidence
DEFECT-03 Critical
Meeting Stability and Termination
Area: Session stability · Dashboard status sync
Issue
Meetings are terminating prematurely, often within two minutes of initiation.
Issue
There is a discrepancy in the dashboard status, where a meeting is displayed as "In Progress", but upon opening, the status reflects as "Ended."
DEFECT-04 High
Phantom "Thank You" Message
Area: Transcription accuracy · Hallucinated content
Issue
There are instances where a "Thank You" message appears in the transcript but was not spoken by any participant during that session.
Evidence
DEFECT-05 High
Missing Transcription
Area: Transcription accuracy · Completeness
Issue
Several words, phrases, and sentences were omitted, resulting in incomplete transcripts.
Evidence
DEFECT-06 Medium
Repeated Content
Area: Transcription accuracy · Readability
Issue
The transcript contained repeated words and sentences, reducing readability and transcription quality.
Evidence
DEFECT-07 Critical
Incorrect Language Transcription
Area: Transcription accuracy · Multilingual handling
Issue
Spoken English was sometimes transcribed into Urdu (or vice versa), causing incorrect language representation in multilingual conversations.
Evidence
DEFECT-08 High
Random Word Insertion
Area: Transcription accuracy · Hallucinated content
Issue
The transcription pipeline adds random words that were not actually spoken, inserting extraneous content into the transcript.
Evidence
DEFECT-09 Medium
Delayed Bot Join
Area: Bot join / session lifecycle
Issue
In some cases, the bot takes too much time to join the meeting — sometimes 5 minutes or more.
